body:
Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7), it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Using https://store.godotengine.org/asset/nonormal/qoi/ as an example:

```
$ ls -l before/
total 12
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo   40 May 18 20:59 bin/
-rw-r--r--. 1 hugo hugo 1368 May 18 20:59 qoiformat.gdextension
-rw-r--r--. 1 hugo hugo   19 May 18 20:59 qoiformat.gdextension.uid
-rw-r--r--. 1 hugo hugo 1107 May 18 20:59 SConstruct
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo  240 May 18 20:59 src/
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo  200 May 18 20:59 testimages/

$ ls -l after/
total 12
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo   40 May 18 21:07 bin/
-rw-rw-rw-. 1 hugo hugo 1368 May 18 21:07 qoiformat.gdextension
-rw-r--r--. 1 hugo hugo   20 May 18 21:07 qoiformat.gdextension.uid
-rw-rw-rw-. 1 hugo hugo 1107 May 18 21:07 SConstruct
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo  240 May 18 21:07 src/
drwxr-xr-x. 2 hugo hugo  200 May 18 21:07 testimages/
```

For reference, we use the same code when installing export templates:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7/editor/export/export_template_manager.cpp#L1494-L1500

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ef02314f2bd0305035ecbe907883401a393da7a7/editor/export/export_template_manager.cpp#L371-L374

In terms of security, it should be fine as this is what native OS file managers do when extracting ZIP archives.

The same code is used for export template extraction. But does every ZIP have valid Unix permissions (what about ZIPs created on Windows)? It might be worth at least checking if it's not `000` before setting.
